dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 03, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Philly's Five-Run Surge Powers Past Nationals, St. Louis Cards Blast Yankees**

In a thrilling night of Major League Baseball, the Philadelphia Phillies outlasted the Washington Nationals 6-3, while the St. Louis Cardinals erupted for 13 runs in a 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees. The Phillies' Bryce Harper continued his power surge with his 24th home run of the season, a fly ball to center field that scored Justin Crawford. 

In the St. Louis win, Alec Burleson went deep three times, driving in six runs, as the Cardinals' offense exploded in a 13-7 thrashing of the Yankees. Logan Webb also dominated on the mound, tossing six scoreless innings with eight strikeouts to lead the San Francisco Giants to a 5-1 victory over the Texas Rangers. 

In the American League, Ian Seymour and the Tampa Bay Rays took down the Colorado Rockies 13-9, with Junior Caminero hitting two home runs and driving in three runs.
